Note any critical steps not completed to standard. Candidate must remediate all failed steps before certification.
Documents incident accurately; reports to correct authority without delay
PCR completed accurately; all fields documented; submitted on time
Organized, accurate patient status update delivered to receiving EMS team
Instructions clear and appropriate; bystander responds correctly
Communicates calmly; explains each procedure before performing it
Correct PPE selected and worn before patient contact; no contamination
Verbalizes scene safe before approach; identifies all hazards and MOI/NOI
Direct pressure sustained; tourniquet applied correctly if indicated
All four steps completed without interruption to CPR cycle
100–120/min; ≥2 in depth; correct hand position; full chest recoil
Correct technique for condition; appropriate device selected; flow rate applied
Systematic head-to-toe; life threats identified; AVPU verbalized correctly
Communicates respectfully across all levels; active listening demonstrated
Demonstrates honesty; upholds code of conduct; handles conflict appropriately
Present and on time for all sessions; communicates absence appropriately
